description: Belt effect within crash configuration: Evans DPC risk ratio (crash-cluster bootstrap CI), matched-pair OR (two-occupant vehicles, one death), within-vehicle conditional logit OR (main model) and the survivor-misreporting fraction that brings each estimate to no effect (tipping point), by harmonised crash type and by vehicle rollover.  The crash-type strata partition the eligible vehicles; the rollover strata exclude vehicles with unknown rollover; the two partitions overlap each other
population: FARS 2016-2024 occupants (driver/passenger) of in-transport light passenger vehicles, seat front-left/front-other/second row, age 13+, belted or unbelted, known outcome
method: Same estimators as the pooled analysis, applied to the vehicles of each stratum (2000 bootstrap replicates over crashes); tipping_point_f = f at which the RR/OR reaches 1 under the one-sided scenario (a fraction f of belted survivors truly unbelted); rows 'pooled' are a check on the pooled estimate (CI differs by bootstrap seed).  Associations given a fatal crash in the vehicle
